To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The bottom frame structure with seismic wall has good seismic performance, but the structure with seismic wall and filled with concrete wall has poor seismic performance.
the seismic damage of the bottom frame structure is mainly concentrated in the bottom layer and the second layer of the structure, and that the seismic performance of the whole structure is poor.

the structure with reinforced concrete anti-seismic wall and filled wall in the bottom layer can effectively improve the seismic performance of the structure, but the structure will produce torsional coupling response under earthquake, which will increase the damage of the upper structure, and eventually lead to the destruction of whole structure.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the seismic behavior of bottom frame structure with reinforced concrete anti seismic walls, and provides a theoretical basis for the seismic design of similar structures.
the seismic performance of the masonry building with the bottom frame structure, and it is helpful to the seismic performance analysis of the similar structures.
the damage of the structure with bottom frame structure, and the seismic performance analysis of the structure is helpful for the reconstruction of the building after the earthquake.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the seismic performance of bottom frame structure is poor.
the structure of the building with bottom frame structure is not recommended.
, the seismic performance of the building with frame and seismic walls in the lower stories is not good, and the seismic design of the structure should be further improved.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the seismic performance of the structure with bottom frame and anti seismic wall is good, but the seismic performance of structure with bottom frame, seismic wall, and filled wall is worse.

in the design of the seismic performance of the building with frame and wall, it is necessary to strengthen the anti seismic performance of the bottom layer of structure, and the anti seismic performance is not enough to be the weak floor of masonry floor, so as to avoid the destruction of the entire structure.
the seismic performance of the structure is greatly affected by the seismic wall and the eccentricity of the structure.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the bottom layer of structure with reinforced concrete anti seismic walls and filled walls is not only a good energy dissipation device, but also a good stiffness and resistance device, and the structure has good anti seismic performance.
the structure with excess masonry anti seismic wall and reinforced concrete filled wall in the first floor is not conducive to the overall seismic performance of the structure.
the structure of the bottom layer of masonry buildings should be reinforced, and the structure of the second layer should be strengthened to improve the seismic performance.
